title: Machinery, Robotics, Constructs & Industrial-System Engineering Adapter Pack
objective: Implement the distinct machinery, robotics, constructs and industrial-system engineering adapter seam over their existing owner, autonomy/control and facility contexts without collapsing those domains into PPIA-04 Vehicle semantics or creating parallel owner ledgers.
acceptance: Machinery, robotics, constructs and industrial systems use a distinct MERA adapter seam where their owner/control/facility bindings differ from PPIA-04 Vehicle semantics.
Existing owner identity, autonomy/control, facility and network state remains authoritative.
Target-specific engineering behavior comes only from explicit owner/profile definitions.
Unknown or conflicting owner/control/facility evidence remains unresolved for operations that require it.
Sealed MERA predecessor affordances compose without changing owner boundaries.
Blocking machinery/robotics/construct/industrial engineering remains semantic/nonvisual and provider-off.
boundaries: MERA-16 does not replace machinery, robotics, construct, industrial, autonomy/control or facility owner domains.
PPIA-04 Vehicle semantics are not silently applied where these targets bind different owner/control/facility contracts.
MERA creates no second machinery, robotics, construct, industrial, control, facility, resource or provenance ledger.
MERA-24 golden cross-domain proof remains unauthorized until MERA-16 completes.
MBES remains blocked until MERA completes at MERA-24.
